movies.title: A Merry Friggin' Christmas
movies.overview: A father’s tense Christmas with his eccentric parents turns chaotic when he forgets his son’s gifts and races home to retrieve them before dawn.

movies.title: Once Upon a Christmas Crown
movies.overview: Princess Charlotte of Marovia escapes her royal life to find herself and love in a New England town during a secret Christmas baking competition.

movies.title: Christmas on Candy Cane Lane
movies.overview: A local Christmas shop owner struggles to live up to her mother's reputation as the town's source of Christmas spirit in the tight-knit community of Candy Cane Lane.

movies.title: A Dash of Christmas
movies.overview: To apply for her dream job at a foodie startup, an executive must learn to bake. When she recruits a handsome baker to help her, she inadvertently ends up entered in a Christmas Bakeoff.

movies.title: Christmas on Windmill Way
movies.overview: An old flame resurfaces when Mia's grandmother decides to sell the family windmill, triggering a race against time to preserve their cherished heritage.

movies.title: Black Christmas
movies.overview: While trapped in their house, sorority sisters become the targets of an escaped homicidal maniac who stalks and torments his unsuspecting victims.

movies.title: Saving Christmas Spirit
movies.overview: When an archaeologist discovers the importance of letting a little festive wonder back into her life, she stumbles upon both history and love.

movies.title: Crown Prince of Christmas
movies.overview: An aspiring musician's family believes her co-worker at an upscale hotel is a member or a royal family. Little does she know there might be some truth to the rumors.

movies.title: Merry Mystery Christmas
movies.overview: Mystery and romance are in the air this Christmas! A reporter and detective discover something unexpected as they work together to solve a mystery.

movies.title: A Miracle in Spanish Harlem
movies.overview: This family-friendly movie is about love, faith and redemption. The movie has a Latin flavor, but its subject matter, cloaked in the Christmas spirit, is universal. Beautiful and alone, Eva feels a spark of romantic interest when she meets Tito, a widower struggling with the loss of a wife, the loss of hope and the loss of his faith. Tito is consumed by the pressures of caring for his children and trying to keep a failing business above water. His growing bitterness overshadows the best parts of his character and drives him to actions that will only add disgrace to his woes. Without a friend left on earth, nothing short of a miracle can relieve Tito's crushing and solitary burdens. However, miracles have been known to happen…

movies.title: The Christmas Listing
movies.overview: Starring Lexi Giovagnoli. Julia is a hardworking realty owner who has lost her Christmas spirit. She will have to spend five days at a Christmas Inn with her business competitor, Chad Everest.

movies.title: Bush Christmas
movies.overview: In the Australian outback a family struggles to keep its farm from foreclosure. Their only hope is that their horse, Prince, will win money in a New Year's race. But when Prince is stolen the children embark on a dangerous and exciting adventure to get him back.

movies.title: Every Time a Bell Rings
movies.overview: Three estranged sisters fulfill their dad's last wish, a Christmas scavenger hunt to find a prized family heirloom, but most importantly, to find each other again. Stars Erin Cahill, Brittany Ishibashi, Ali Liebert, and Wes Brown.

movies.title: A Merry Christmas Match
movies.overview: A woman working in her mother’s ski village antique shop meets a man who makes her wonder if she should have left town and followed her dreams.

movies.title: Nostalgic Christmas
movies.overview: When Anne helps her father close the family's toy store, what she finds will help inspire an entire town that is need of some Christmas cheer. Starring Brooke D'Orsay and Trevor Donovan.

movies.title: Christmas Bells Are Ringing
movies.overview: Una fotógrafa regresa a Cape Cod para celebrar la Navidad y la boda de su padre, donde encuentra un nuevo significado a su fotografía y se enamora.

movies.title: Reunited at Christmas
movies.overview: Samantha's divided family, and boyfriend Simon, all return to Nana's house to honor her memory and relive their lost Christmas traditions. Stars Nikki Deloach, Mike Fiola.

movies.title: A Dream of Christmas
movies.overview: When a restless young married woman is granted a wish by a Christmas Angel to be single again, she soon discovers her new life isn't what she bargained for, and embarks on a quest to win her husband back.

movies.title: A Very Charming Christmas Town
movies.overview: Lifestyle blogger Aubrey Lang goes to the little town of Solvang for her next holiday vlog piece after it's voted Most Christmassy Town in the USA.

movies.title: Tails of Christmas
movies.overview: After an injury cuts his career short, a retired soldier discovers a newfound purpose and love at an animal shelter owned by a local woman.

movies.title: Where God Left His Shoes
movies.overview: A failed boxer (John Leguizamo) struggles to find a job and an apartment for his family on Christmas Eve.

movies.title: Christmas Time Is Here
movies.overview: Romance, real estate and family ties collide when a realtor falls in love with a big-time client intent on buying her father's cozy inn.

movies.title: A Bluegrass Christmas
movies.overview: Katie's family's horse sanctuary is on the brink of closure, but in a last-ditch effort to raise the money, Katie must coax her reclusive grandfather, Bluegrass legend Ben Pendleton, back onto the stage for a Christmas benefit concert.

movies.title: The Great Christmas Switch
movies.overview: To escape their problems, identical twins Bianca, a city girl with an overbearing boss, and Kaelynn, a single mother of two, decide to switch places for Christmas.

movies.title: Another Christmas
movies.overview: Kelly Brooks is an elementary school teacher who gave up on love during the holiday season until her childhood friend Andrew a professional baseball player returns home to win Kelly's heart for Christmas.

movies.title: Wham!: Last Christmas Unwrapped
movies.overview: In celebration of its 40th anniversary, this nostalgic Christmas special tells the story of how George Michael and Andrew Ridgeley's WHAM! turned one song into a cultural phenomenon.

movies.title: He Sees You When You're Sleeping
movies.overview: A young man's Christmas homecoming becomes a nightmare when a killer in a Santa suit targets his estranged, wealthy family for their fortune.

movies.title: Never Kiss a Man in a Christmas Sweater
movies.overview: Single mom Maggie is facing Christmas alone until Lucas crashes into her life and becomes an unexpected houseguest. Together they overcome Christmas while finding comfort in their growing bond.[W Network]

movies.title: #300Letters
movies.overview: When Tom suddenly abandons his boyfriend Jero, he leaves behind a box containing 299 letters written throughout their time together - revealing new, previously unknown layers of their relationship. A darkly funny, unconventional breakup movie from director Lucas Santa Ana, '300 Letters' plays like a rom-com in reverse, exploring the messy process of rediscovering yourself after heartbreak.

movies.title: Merry Switchmas
movies.overview: The holidays take a wrong turn when identical twin sisters agree to switch places for one night only at their parents' Christmas party.

movies.title: Frosty the Snowman
movies.overview: Discover how everyone's favorite happy, jolly soul came to life one day in the original holiday special, Frosty the Snowman!

movies.title: An All Dogs Christmas Carol
movies.overview: A canine criminal tries to ruin Christmas for everyone by stealing presents. He’s then visited by three ghosts who persuade him to change his ways.

movies.title: Jingle All the Way to Love
movies.overview: Andi receives a lucky sleigh bell from a handsome stranger at a New Year's party, only to pass it on. Years later, she wins a radio contest and the host, Jake, turns her story into a segment.

movies.title: Jingle & Bell's Christmas Star
movies.overview: Jingle the Husky Pup is back and joined with some new friends, including Sophia and her Husky Pup Bell who are new to town. With their world turned upside down, this looks to them like it could be the worst Christmas ever.

movies.title: A Christmas to Savour
movies.overview: Scarlett is a chef and co-owner of a restaurant. This year, her best friend buys her a ticket to a holiday cooking getaway, where Scarlett will relearn festive cooking, and maybe find love in a handsome rival chef from her past.

movies.title: The Killing Tree
movies.overview: A widow casts an ancient spell on Christmas Eve to resurrect her executed husband, but it goes wrong and he returns as an evil Christmas tree.

movies.title: A Novel Christmas
movies.overview: When children's author Chloe returns to Noelleville for her first Christmas without her mom, she finds healing in family, inspiration in a single dad and his daughter, and the courage to write a new story-both on the page and in her heart.

movies.title: Inventing the Christmas Prince
movies.overview: Shelby is about to quit her job as a rocket engineer when her daughter becomes convinced that her Scrooge-like boss, Evan, is the Christmas Prince; a story Shelby invented years ago. [W Network]

movies.title: A Chrismystery
movies.overview: A big-city cop reluctantly returns with her daughter to her hometown taking a deputy sheriff job. Though determined not to stay, when the town's Christmas lights, decorations, and tree are stolen, she sets her mind on the case where everyone is a suspect. Solving the holiday mystery, along with the charming sheriff, she may just discover that love is always a gift worth giving.

movies.title: My Christmas Fiancé
movies.overview: A part-time student at a resort restaurant in beautiful Italy is hired by her boss to pose as his fiancée for the holidays, so he can avoid getting married.

movies.title: Mistletoe & Molly
movies.overview: Broke waitress Molly is desperate for a Christmas miracle - and to escape her overbearing dad... until she meets a man just like him. What's a gal to do?

movies.title: Season of Light: Christmas with the Tabernacle Choir
The Santa Claus Brothers
movies.overview: Santa Claus has three sons. And there's a reason why they aren't in charge of Christmas.

movies.title: Noise
movies.overview: Graham McGahan is a cop - almost by default he thinks. Self-centred, beset with doubt and afflicted with tinnitus, a few days before Christmas he is sent by his boss to man a police van in a suburban shopping strip, after violent murders rock the local community. McGahan starts to engage with traumatised members of the local community, as they deal with the afterburn of these terrible crimes. He learns to come to grips with his role as a cop and a man. But terror has a way of finding the most vulnerable amongst us. NOISE deals with the response of an ordinary young man, to the challenge posed when a community is affected by tragic events. The film shows we are at our best when the worst occurs.

movies.title: Santa's Chimney of Secrets
movies.overview: Two kids, discovering their chimney's link to a magical realm, embark on a quest with an elf to find the missing Santa Claus and save Christmas.

movies.title: Barbie in the Nutcracker
movies.overview: Barbie plays Clara, who befriends a nutcracker that comes to life. When the Mouse King shrinks the duo, only the Sugarplum Fairy can break the spell.

movies.title: Hats Off to Christmas!
movies.overview: A widowed mother loyal to her job expects a promotion when the boss plans to retire, but he instead hands the shop over to his reluctant son.

movies.title: The Christmas Bow
movies.overview: When an accident puts her music dreams on hold, a gifted violinist reconnects with an old family friend, who helps her heal and find love during the holidays.

movies.title: Coopers' Camera
movies.overview: Celebrate the holidays with Jason Jones and Samantha Bee, plus KIDS IN THE HALL's Dave Foley. Using a professional grade video camera, a dysfunctional family records their Christmas Day in 1985, which descends into total chaos.

movies.title: I'm Glad It's Christmas
movies.overview: An aspiring Broadway singer is convinced to participate in a small-scale production for her local Christmas celebration.

movies.title: Catering Christmas
movies.overview: Molly Frost is struggling to launch her new catering business when she unexpectedly lands New Hampshire's biggest event of the year and takes Carson Harrison, on a journey to learn about all the good his family's foundation provides.

movies.title: Christmas in Tahoe
movies.overview: To save her family hotel's Christmas show, talent booker Claire must ask for help from her ex-boyfriend Ryan, the lead guitarist of a now-famous band that fired her as their manager years ago. Laura Osnes, Kyle Selig, Pat Monahan.

movies.title: A Christmas in New Hope
movies.overview: A budding romance with her musician neighbor could cost a single mom and her special needs daughter the chance to keep a roof over their heads.

movies.title: Operation Nutcracker
movies.overview: When an antique nutcracker set to be auctioned at the Warby family Christmas charity goes missing, a demanding event planner and the heir to the Warby dynasty try to track it down.

movies.title: Santa Claws
movies.overview: When Santa suffers a major allergic reaction in the middle of his delivery route, it’s up to a litter of kittens aboard his sleigh to save Christmas.

movies.title: Loving Christmas
movies.overview: Ashley has always been the "Christmas Queen" in town. From making decorations to hosting the Christmas sweater competition, she loves the holiday...until she meets her match. Ben is the new guy in town who loves Christmas and unwittingly begins to steal her thunder. As Ashley starts to feel sad, she's reminded of the spirit of the holiday, and joins him to make this Christmas even more meaningful.

movies.title: Santa Stole Our Dog: A Merry Doggone Christmas!
movies.overview: On Christmas Eve, Santa Claus accidentally steals the family dog. Determined to get it back, the family embarks on a trip to the North Pole.

movies.title: How the Gringo Stole Christmas
movies.overview: A Mexican American dad is forced to navigate an uninvited holiday surprise when his daughter shows up for Christmas with her clueless white boyfriend.

movies.title: Charlie's Christmas Wish
movies.overview: A war veteran finds inspiration in his son’s spirited new terrier, who helps bring the town together in time to build homes for displaced veterans.

movies.title: Stationed At Home
movies.overview: On a cold Christmas Eve in 1998, a lone taxi driver breathlessly awaits the International Space Station, but a string of quirky, lovable misfits disrupt his plans, setting off a madcap tale of heartwarming unity and unexpected hope.

movies.title: Krampus Unleashed
movies.overview: Scavengers unearth an ancient stone and awaken the bloodthirsty Krampus, a Christmas demon whose appetite won’t be satisfied by milk and cookies.

movies.title: Music City Mistletoe
movies.overview: In Nashville, a spirited songwriter and a widowed consultant clash over the fate of a struggling music publishing office. As Christmas nears, rivalry turns to romance in this conflict-filled tale where saving dreams means risking hearts.

movies.title: Krampus: The Reckoning
movies.overview: An odd little girl summons a legendary demon spirit, Santa’s dark counterpart, and unleashes him to punish those she deems naughty at Christmastime.

movies.title: Toying with the Holidays
movies.overview: Danielle (Cindy Busby) returns home with her son and hopes to introduce him to some beloved holiday traditions. She discovers that the North Pole Express has been sidelined and with help from a former classmate (Chad Michael Murray) is resolute to fix it.

movies.title: North
movies.overview: When Kai mysteriously vanishes, brave young Gerda embarks on an extraordinary journey to find him. Facing danger, magic, and unexpected allies, she discovers the sinister Snow Queen has imprisoned Kai in her frozen palace in Norway. Gerda must outwit the icy queen, rescue her friend, and race home for a Christmas they'll never forget.

movies.title: Holiday Touchdown: A Bills Love Story
movies.overview: Childhood friends, Morgan and Gabe aren't just football fans... they're Buffalo Bills mega fans. Every year, to celebrate the game right before Christmas, their families host a Holiday Tailgate Dinner and take a photo outside of Highmark Stadium. And since Santa's bringing the Bills a shiny, new stadium next season, this is going to be a Christmas they'll never forget.

movies.title: She's Making a List
movies.overview: A woman falls for a widower while evaluating if his child should be on Santa's naughty or nice list.

movies.title: Christmas on Duty
movies.overview: Blair and Josh have been bitter rivals ever since they trained together at The Basic School in Quantico, where they were both at the top of the class, competing to be number one. After graduation, Blair got Josh's dream job, and they haven't spoken since. Three years later, their paths cross unexpectedly at The Marine Corps Ball, where the two get into an argument and cause a scene.

movies.title: You, Me and the Christmas Trees
movies.overview: A Hallmark Channel original movie. Olivia (Danica McKellar) is Connecticut’s resident expert on evergreens who, just days before the holiday, agrees to help Jack (Benjamin Ayres), a fourth generation Christmas tree farmer in Avon. A mysterious illness has befallen their firs, causing them to die out and threatening his family’s 100-year business.

movies.title: Too Close for Christmas
movies.overview: Sparks unexpectedly fly when an event planner is forced to spend Christmas with the man whose meddling comments helped end her last relationship.

movies.title: The Magic Snowflake
movies.overview: Young Nicolas agrees to do Santa's work for one year. But the stress of the job threatens the boy's sense of joy--and Christmas itself

movies.title: Christmas in Paris
movies.overview: A gorgeous French millionaire meets the woman of his dreams: the beautiful Art Director on his photo shoot. But while in Paris on a Christmas adventure,a secret could push them apart forever. TV-G

movies.overview: Emma Warner, as a SVP of a toy company, spends 12 months a year focusing on Christmas, leaving no time for dating. This year, she plans a trip to a tropical singles resort, but a booking mistake takes her to a Christmas obsessed town.

movies.title: A Carpool Karaoke Christmas
movies.overview: Take an international road trip with Dua Lipa in Japan, Chappell Roan in her Missouri hometown, and Lady Gaga in LA.

movies.title: Destined at Christmas
movies.overview: Two people who meet on Black Friday but get separated before exchanging last names and numbers find some help from destiny before Christmas.

movies.title: Faith In The Family: The Spirit of Christmas
movies.overview: Faith in the Family: The Spirit of Christmas explores the Andersons' struggles with grief, faith, and healing during the holidays, culminating in a transformative Christmas morning.

movies.title: Holiday Harmony
movies.overview: A talented underdog gets momentarily sidelined from chasing her musical dreams when her van breaks down in a small town just before Christmas.

movies.title: A Carol Christmas
movies.overview: G. A heartless corporate CEO is shown the error of her ways by four ghosts, changing her attitude in time for Christmas.

movies.title: The Christmas Baby
movies.overview: Erin and Kelly find a baby on their doorstep during the holidays.

movies.title: Mario Lopez Presents: Chasing Christmas
movies.overview: When a Christmas wishes tree brings together an artist and a morning show host, they set out on a mission to make a child's holiday dreams come true.

movies.title: A Make or Break Holiday

However, relaying this news to their opinionated families will most certainly ruin Christmas, so they decide the only logical thing to do is to pretend to still be a happy couple while everyone’s under one roof. What could go wrong?

movies.title: Husky Christmas

movies.title: Have We Met This Christmas?
movies.overview: After a car wreck leaves her with amnesia, a real estate exec recovers at a small town inn.

movies.overview: Injured pro-hockey player Wes Campbell turns to equine therapy at Keller Ranch in Nashville, where he meets rancher Maggie Keller, leading to unexpected healing and a holiday romance.

movies.title: The Christmas Royal Romance
movies.overview: After inheriting her late neighbor’s cottage, a shy school teacher finds a foreign prince hiding out there who’d fled his country’s political unrest.

movies.title: Kevin Costner Presents: The First Christmas
movies.overview: Exploring the extraordinary journey of Mary and Joseph.

movies.title: Dead Before Christmas
movies.overview: A Christmas romance turns dark when a real estate mogul falls for a woman hiding a deadly web of lies and murder that soon puts his life at risk.

movies.title: A Christmas Murder Mystery

movies.title: The Hallmark Christmas Experience: A Hometown Holiday Christmas Special
movies.overview: Join your favorite Hallmark stars for a Christmas extravaganza in Kansas City.

movies.overview: On a wildly unpredictable Christmas Eve, a cynical Scrooge is thrust into a nightmarish journey through time by ghostly forces, reliving bitter regrets, facing the fallout of his cruelty, and glimpsing a future shaped by his every misdeed.

movies.title: Tangled Up in Christmas
movies.overview: A workaholic joins forces with her free-spirited sister to plan a Christmas charity event as secrets and a budding romance complicate the holidays.

movies.title: Matt Rife: Unwrapped - A Christmas Crowd Work Special
movies.overview: From gifts gone wrong to family tradition fails, Matt Rife turns an unpredictable audience into an unscripted holiday special.

movies.overview: Grand Ole Opry magic takes Gentry and her friend, Mac, back in time to Christmas 1995, she's able to spend time with her late country star dad, as well as discover romance with Mac. Stars Nikki DeLoach, Kristoffer Polaha.

movies.title: Hank’s Christmas Wish 3: Elvis Lives
movies.overview: When a biker gang threatens Christmas, two friends join forces to protect their town while one of them searches for renewed purpose.

movies.title: A Chuck E. Cheese Christmas
movies.overview: Join Chuck E. Cheese and friends for a magical Christmas adventure full of music, laughter, and holiday cheer!  Chuck E. plans a surprise party to lift Santa's spirits with help from his pals: Helen, Jasper, Bella, Pasqually, and Munch.  But surprising the man who "sees you when you're sleeping and knows when you're awake" won't be easy. Can they pull it off in time to save Christmas?

movies.title: The Christmas Cookbook

The Christmas Ticket

movies.title: Christmas For The Soul
movies.overview: An activist-chef caters a Christmas dinner for a wealthy family whose plans threaten her neighborhood.

movies.title: Finding Christmas
movies.overview: Mikey Finnegan, a 17-year-old from Philly, dreams of becoming a pro gamer. After a Christmas Eve attack leaves him in a coma, he travels back to Bethlehem. Guided by a Guardian Angel, he must find baby Jesus to return home.

movies.title: Gingersnap Christmas
movies.overview: Alesha hates Christmas so she reluctantly agrees to visit her Caribbean grandmother to help organize her annual Christmas charity function to save her clinic. When she arrives with her best friend, Alesha meets a handsome Brit, Garrett Graham.

movies.title: Christmas in the Friendly Skies
movies.overview: A chance encounter on a turbulent flight leads to an unexpected romance between two strangers who find comfort in each other's company amidst the chaos of air travel

movies.title: A Not So Straight Christmas
movies.overview: Karen is disillusioned with Christmas this year and decides to distance herself from her chosen family. However, she soon realizes her mistake and finds herself in a vulnerable position on Christmas Eve. Seeking solace, she reaches out to an old flame.

movies.title: Mixed Christmas
movies.overview: Aurora wants to enjoy the holidays this year in some warmth and sunshine, and invites her three best friends to Miami for a Christmas trip to remember. When they arrive at their AirBnb, they discover it's been double booked...by Aurora's ex-girlfriend and her new partner Axel. They have no choice but to combine their plans, and celebrate the holiday together.

movies.title: Our Dream Christmas
movies.overview: Gabby and her family spend one last Christmas in LA with her dying mom, where secrets are revealed that could threaten their tranquility.

movies.title: The Great Christmas Snow-In
movies.overview: Justin retreats to a secluded cabin, only to be snowed-in with Jane, his ex-fiancee's cousin. As sparks start to fly, the arrival of Justin's ex and her new boyfriend forces everyone to confront their pasts and reconsider what they want from love.

movies.title: We're Scrooged
movies.overview: TV-PG. Ex-high school sweethearts reunite at their high school reunion only to learn they will be visited by 3 Christmas ghosts over the next 3 days. While dreaming each night, they have shared experiences reliving their past and present Christmases.

movies.title: A Scottish Christmas Secret
movies.overview: Publisher goes to Scotland to get author to finish series; she uncovers he's the heir to a dukedom.

movies.title: Make or Bake Christmas
movies.overview: With her eye on buying a bakery, Emma goes undercover as a seasonal employee during Christmas—but falls for the shop, the season, and a coworker.

movies.title: The Spirit of Christmas Station
movies.overview: With a Christmas deadline approaching, an editor retreats to her family’s cabin, where a local rancher helps her revive the town’s spirit—and her own.

movies.title: A Christmas Frequency
movies.overview: A radio show producer sets her boss up on live on-air blind dates to save their dying show, but inadvertently falls for one of the contenders.

movies.title: Christmas with a Prince
movies.overview: When a prince is injured during a polo match, the doctor treating him at the hospital is a romantically scorned classmate from boarding school.

movies.title: A Country Music Christmas

movies.title: The Holiday Exchange

movies.title: Home Sweet Christmas
movies.overview: A successful lawyer returns home after inheriting part of a maple forest farm. As she reconnects with her childhood friend who co-owns the property, she'll get a chance to reexamine what matters most.

movies.title: Reporting for Christmas
movies.overview: Assigned a holiday puff piece, a cynical reporter meets a charming toymaker who inspires her to look beyond her story and find true happiness.

movies.title: A Royal Christmas Hope
movies.overview: At Christmas, a charitable non-profit founder and a mysterious prince from St. Monica cross paths in NYC. As sparks fly and secrets build, love may be the greatest gift of all-if truth doesn't ruin it.

movies.title: A Christmas Blessing
movies.overview: Renowned TV star Mandy plans a globe-trotting sabbatical but stops to settle her late aunt's food pantry-and meets a businessman who changes her plans.

movies.title: Christmas Everyday

movies.title: Planes, Trains, and Christmas Trees
movies.overview: During a business trip, event planner Kayley and sports agent Brett find themselves unable to fly home for Christmas due to a snowstorm. Determined to get back to NYC by Christmas Eve, the two team up and try to make their own way home.

movies.title: The Christmas Campaign

movies.title: Christmas Keepsake
movies.overview: A father and his daughter find a Christmas time capsule buried in their backyard and set out to find its original owner.

movies.title: Christmas with a Kiss
movies.overview: A woman returns home for her family's Christmas Carnival and a romance ignites.

movies.title: Welcome to Christmas
movies.overview: Sheriff Gage McBride and the residents of tiny Christmas, Colorado work to convince resort developer Madison Lane to build her company’s newest resort nearby, to save the struggling town. Madison finds herself falling for the charming town, the handsome widowed sheriff and his family who have embraced her as one of their own...

movies.title: A Christmas Less Traveled
movies.overview: As Desi faces the dilemma of selling her late father's beloved truck, a chance encounter with a handsome stranger leads to a transformative road trip where they find the courage to embrace the future.

movies.title: Almost Christmas
movies.overview: A beloved patriarch asks his family to get along during the holidays, but it'll be a miracle if they can be together without killing one another.

movies.title: Happy Holla Day

movies.overview: Andie and her mother Mimi run a company called The Holiday Junkie, a decorating and planning service for all holiday needs. But after Mimi passes away, Andie is forced to face her first Christmas without her mother.

movies.title: A Christmas Proposal
movies.overview: A down-on-her-luck chef, who dreams of starting her own line of food trucks, agrees to pose as the girlfriend of a hotshot Seattle attorney, visiting his family for Christmas, to help him prove he's the ideal candidate to take over the family firm. But their business arrangement is complicated by the magic of the season as real sparks begin to fly.

movies.title: Yes, Chef! Christmas
movies.overview: A woman who put her career aspirations and personal life aside enters a cooking competition, where she learns a life-changing family secret.
